萧凡入城（萧凡入城（第22页）醉汉被吓得酒醒了大半，看着眼前这个杀气腾腾的青年，结结巴巴道：“萧……萧家……三天前就被抄了！满门抄斩！说是勾结北蛮……被忠义侯汪海带兵抄的家！”萧凡瞳孔猛地一缩。抄家！“萧家的人呢？全死了？”“全……全死了……”醉汉吓得浑身发抖，“一百三十七口人，一夜之间全没了……就剩一个，萧家大小姐萧璃月，据说被汪海带回府里了……”轰！萧凡脑海中仿佛有惊雷炸响。他松开醉汉，踉跄后退两步，脑海中浮现出妹妹那张稚气未脱的小脸。璃月……那个小时候总是跟在他身后的小丫头……萧凡的眼眶瞬间红了，一股滔天杀意从心底狂涌而出，周身气势暴涨，宗师九重的威压如山岳般碾压下来，压得那个醉汉瘫软在地，几乎喘不过气来。“汪！海！”萧凡从齿缝间挤出这两个字。他转身就要往忠义侯府的方向冲去，却忽然停住脚步。不对。师尊说过，行事切莫冲动。他深吸一口气，将翻涌的杀意强行压下，转头看向瘫在地上的醉汉，声音冰冷如铁。“汪海什么修为？”“后……后天……”醉汉哆嗦着答道，“后天七重……据说……”“后天七重？”萧凡眼中闪过一丝轻蔑。区区后天七重，也敢动他萧家？“那忠义侯府有多少护卫？”“这……这小人不知……只听说府上养了几十个护院，修为都不高……”萧凡冷冷点头，转身消失在夜色中。醉汉瘫在地上，大口大口地喘着粗气，浑身冷汗淋漓。过了许久，他才慢慢爬起来，看向萧凡消失的方向，目光忽然变得锐利起来。那醉汉从袖中摸出一块玉符，轻轻捏碎。一道肉眼不可见的灵光冲天而起，飞向汪府的位置。……天阙城，忠义侯府。青鸢持枪而立。身后一名凤卫凑过来，压低声音。“暗哨传来消息，南城萧家门口附近发现可疑人物，疑似萧凡。”青鸢眸中精光一闪。“确定是萧凡？”“七成把握。那人从南门进城，径直去了萧家旧址，打听过汪侯爷的事。”青鸢沉默片刻，嘴角勾起一抹冷冽的弧度。“既然他已经现身，那不如主动出击。”她转身就要下令，一个声音忽然从身后传来。“且慢。”青鸢脚步一顿，转过身去。汪海不知何时已经出现在厅门口，脸上挂着那副让人想打的表情。“汪侯爷竟有闲情雅致出门？”青鸢的语气带着毫不掩饰的嘲讽。她本以为这个酒色之徒会一直窝在温柔乡里不出来。汪海对她的嘲讽毫不在意，笑眯眯地走到她身边。“青鸢统领说笑了，本侯虽然贪图享乐，但性命攸关的事还是上心的。”“那你还拦我？”青鸢冷冷道，“现在出击，打他个措手不及，胜算最大。”汪海摇了摇头。“萧凡身上有大气运，主动出击容易打草惊蛇，让他逃走，反而得不偿失。”青鸢眉头皱得更紧。“那你要怎样？”“自然是守株待兔。”汪海伸手朝厅内一指，能看见萧璃月正跪在软榻前，姿态卑微。“有她在，不用担心萧凡不出现。”青鸢顺着他的手指望去，眼中闪过一丝厌恶。她深吸一口气，将那股恶心压下去。“你确定他会来？”“百分之百。”汪海语气笃定，“萧凡这个人，重情重义到了偏执的程度。他既然知道妹妹在我手里，哪怕明知道是龙潭虎穴也会来闯。这就是他最大的弱点。”青鸢沉默片刻，终于点了点头。“那就依你。我们在府中设伏，等他自投罗网。”“对了。”汪海忽然想起什么，上下打量了青鸢一眼，“你们也乔装打扮一下，免得吓到了萧少爷。”“你什么意思？”青鸢统领问道。汪海贴耳说了几句青鸢统领脸色一黑，险些拔枪。…………

Xiao Fan Enters the City (Xiao Fan Enters the City (Page 22)) The drunk man was so frightened that he was mostly awake. Looking at the murderous young man in front of him, he stammered: "Xiao... Xiao's family... was raided three days ago! The whole family was executed! They said they were colluding with the Northern Barbarians... and their home was ransacked by the troops led by Zhongyi Hou Wang Hai! "Where are the people in the Xiao family? Are they all dead?" The drunkard was trembling with fear. Thirty-seven people were all gone overnight... There was only one left, Xiao Liyue, the eldest daughter of the Xiao family, who was said to have been brought back to the house by Wang Hai... "Boom! Thunder seemed to explode in Xiao Fan's mind. He let go of the drunkard and staggered back two steps, with his sister's childish face appearing in his mind. Liyue... the little girl who always followed him when he was a child... Xiao Fan's eyes instantly turned red, and a monstrous murderous intention surged out of his heart. The momentum around him surged, and the pressure of the ninth level of the Grandmaster was like a mountain, crushing the drunkard to the ground, almost unable to breathe. "Wow! Hai!" Xiao Fan squeezed out these two words from between his teeth. He turned around and rushed towards the Zhongyi Marquis Mansion, but suddenly stopped. No. Master said, don't act impulsively. He took a deep breath, suppressed the surging murderous intention, and turned to look at the drunkard lying on the ground. Like iron. "What kind of cultivation is Wang Hai?" "The day after tomorrow..." the drunkard replied tremblingly, "The seventh level of the day after tomorrow... It is said that..." "The seventh level of the day after tomorrow?" A trace of contempt flashed in Xiao Fan's eyes. Dare to touch the Xiao family? "How many guards does the Zhongyi Hou Mansion have?" "I don't know this little guy... I only heard that there are dozens of guards in the house, and they are not very high-level..." Xiao Fan nodded coldly, turned around and disappeared into the night. Han collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily and dripping with cold sweat. After a long time, he slowly got up and looked towards the direction where Xiao Fan disappeared, and his eyes suddenly became sharp. Crush the jade talisman gently. An invisible light rises into the sky and flies towards the Wang Mansion. Qing Yuan stands with a gun behind him and lowers his voice. News came that a suspicious person was found near the entrance of Xiao's house in Nancheng." Qingyuan's eyes flashed. "Are you sure it's Xiao Fan?" "I'm 70% sure. I heard about Mr. Wang." Qingyuan was silent for a moment, with a cold curve on her lips. "Since he has appeared, it's better to take the initiative." She turned around and was about to give the order, and a voice suddenly came from behind. "And. Slow down." Qing Yuan paused and turned around. Wang Hai had appeared at the door of the hall without knowing it, with an expression that made people want to fight. "Master Wang, you have the leisure to go out elegantly?" Qing Yuan's tone was filled with undisguised sarcasm. She thought that this drunkard would stay in the gentle village forever. Wang Hai didn't care about her ridicule and walked to her with a smile. "Commander Qing Yuan is joking, although I am greedy for enjoyment. "Yes, but life is at stake." "Then you still want to stop me?" Qing Yuan said coldly, "If you attack him by surprise, you have the best chance of winning." Wang Hai shook his head. "Xiao Fan has great luck. Taking the initiative would easily scare the snake and allow him to escape, but the gain would be greater than the gain. "Then what do you want?" "Of course, just wait and see." Wang Hai pointed towards the hall, where he could see Xiao Liyue.Kneeling in front of the soft couch, his posture is humble. "As long as she's here, you don't have to worry about Xiao Fan not showing up." Qingyuan followed his hand, a trace of disgust flashing in her eyes. She took a deep breath to suppress the nausea. "Are you sure he will come?" "One hundred percent." Wang Hai said firmly, "Xiao Fan is a person who values ​​love and justice to the point of paranoia. Since he knows that my sister is in my hands, he will come in even if he knows it is a dragon's pond and a tiger's den. This is his biggest weakness." Qingyuan was silent for a moment, and finally nodded. "Then it's up to you. We'll set up an ambush in the mansion and wait for him to fall into the trap." "That's right." Wang Hai suddenly remembered something and looked Qing Yuan up and down. "You should also dress up in disguise so as not to scare Master Xiao." "What do you mean?" Commander Qing Yuan asked. Wang Hai whispered a few words to Commander Qingyuan's face, and he almost drew his gun. …………
